claims.paraphrase: SC/ST reservations go to the highest SC population-share GPs, totaling 20 percent of the block; an unspecified ST population threshold determines whether one of these is ST.
claims.qualification: The ST population threshold, integer rounding and treatment of tied ranks are not specified in this passage. The description concerns the 1996 Tamil Nadu allocation and does not establish later rule versions.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Tamil Nadu Panchayats Act 1994 and Rural Development and Panchayati Raj documents; published footnote 14 notes some documents obtained through field contacts.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: With complete 1996 block rosters, valid population counts, known rounding and resolved ties, an eligible lower-ranked GP receiving SC reservation while a higher-ranked GP remains unreserved would contradict exact adherence to the stated ranking rule.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.pool: SC/ST and remaining GPs separately within block
claims.paraphrase: The highest third of the SC/ST pool by female-SC share and highest third of the remaining pool by female share receive women reservations.
claims.qualification: Nonrandom assignment is explicit. Female-SC shares and total female shares are different running variables.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: After correctly assigning caste pools, resolved female-share rankings that reserve a lower-ranked eligible GP while skipping a higher-ranked eligible GP would contradict the stated rule; use female-SC shares inside the SC pool.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Reservations last ten years; the next allocation excludes previously caste-reserved GPs from the caste step and previously women-reserved GPs from the general women step.
claims.qualification: The stated ten-year tenure and exclusions concern the Tamil Nadu procedure described by this version; boundary changes, ties and exceptions require contemporaneous administrative records.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: For stable GP boundaries and unchanged applicable rules, reservation changes within the stated ten-year tenure or inclusion of a GP explicitly excluded by prior reservation would contradict this procedure.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.quote: the assignment of reservations is performed imperfectly.
claims.paraphrase: The paper reports block-average errors of 27.3 percent for women reservations and 39.1 percent for SC reservations.
claims.qualification: Its error rate is the proportion of reserved GPs that fail its rank threshold, not all-GP disagreement. Authors report limited evidence of baseline correlates; no complete-population audit is demonstrated here.
claims.evidence_basis: Reported reconstruction and Appendix A baseline comparisons.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Reconstructing the same 12-block sample, thresholds, reserved-GP denominator and equal-block aggregation and obtaining different error rates beyond reported rounding would contradict the numerical report; a different full-roster estimate answers a different question.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: The appendix estimates 14 mismatches: six reserved GPs below its sample threshold and eight unreserved GPs above it.
claims.qualification: Authors lack census-to-GP alignment and full pool female ratios, so use within-sample thresholds. Appendix says three blocks whereas sample description has 12; do not interpret 14/117 as validated legal noncompliance.
claims.evidence_basis: Appendix S 2 text and 2 x 2 table.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Reproducing the same 117 sampled non-SC GPs and the appendix sample-threshold algorithm but not obtaining six false positives and eight false negatives would contradict the reported calculation. Complete-block thresholds would test a different estimand.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Authors argue female reservations are unrelated to unobserved public-goods determinants because sex ratios vary little, most baseline attributes and public goods balance, and DID absorbs fixed differences.
claims.qualification: Christian households and public toilets differ at baseline. This is an identification argument, not a claim of literal random assignment.
claims.evidence_basis: Tables 1--3 and supplemental TableS 1.1; supplemental table not separately available in local PDF corpus.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Evidence that reservation predicts differential pre-reservation public-goods trends after conditioning on the stated design would undermine the DID identification argument. Verified administrative selection using prospective outcomes would more directly contradict the proposed absence of outcome-related selection.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: An RD near the female-share threshold is used as a sensitivity check because excluding SC GPs and restricting bandwidth reduces sample size.
claims.qualification: No claim of statewide exact threshold compliance follows from the RD result.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Replication materials showing no threshold-based sensitivity analysis, or using a different running variable or caste pool from the described analysis, would contradict this design description; failure to detect a jump alone would not establish a violation.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Authors characterize state implementation timing as exogenous, principally reflecting expiry of existing local-government terms.
claims.qualification: Explicit exceptions include early adoption and excluded states; this does not establish within-state random assignment.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Mathew 1995/2000; Government of India 2008; Iyer et al.2012; Appendix Table 1.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Election-calendar and reform records showing that implementation dates were chosen in response to prior or anticipated trends in women entrepreneurship, beyond term expiry and the stated exceptions, would contradict the proposed timing-exogeneity rationale.
claims.required_inputs: State reform dates, prior election calendars and adoption determinants.

claims.paraphrase: Women-reserved constituencies are described as as-if-randomly allocated; supplementary SectionA.1 provides balance checks.
claims.qualification: Supplement not among local PDFs. Survey covers 17 municipal constituencies; this is urban evidence.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Chattopadhyay and Duflo 2004 and Supplementary MaterialA.1.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: A verified 2017 Delhi assignment rule using outcome-related ward characteristics beyond the conditioning set would undermine as-if randomness. Joint balance statistics extreme under the actual assignment mechanism would reject that specified mechanism, without identifying the cause.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Quotas are described as freshly randomized rather than rotated, with results announced a few weeks before elections.
claims.qualification: Specific to Delhi municipal elections; do not transfer this rule to rural GP heads.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Official 2017 Delhi rules or lottery records making prior reservation a binding eligibility constraint would contradict fresh unrestricted randomization; official announcement dates substantially earlier than the described pre-election window would contradict its timing component.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.years: Cycles studied in draft; general procedure
claims.paraphrase: The draft states that high SC/ST population shares determine caste reservation and successive eligible ranks determine later allocations.
claims.qualification: Claimed close adherence rests on TableTBC; OBC data unavailable and ST seats sparse. Higher-order unit is not operationally specified.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Bhavnani 2017; Chauchard 2014; Jensenius 2017.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Within an identified caste allocation pool and cycle, verified eligible higher-population-share seats being skipped for lower-ranked seats after resolving history, rounding and ties would contradict exact implementation of the stated rank rule.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Gender quotas are described as layered within caste categories, with 50 percent in Bihar and 33 percent in UP, using rank-based rotation.
claims.qualification: Exact female ranking variable, rounding, eligibility and historical rule versions are not fully specified in this passage.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Once the relevant state-year rules and rankings are specified, allocations crossing caste pools, violating the stated women quotas after lawful rounding, or skipping eligible ranked seats would contradict the corresponding component of this account.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Limited between-GP female-share variation is argued to make rank assignments approximately quasi-random.
claims.qualification: Own balance evidence points to TableTBC; balance does not establish assignment probabilities or district/block homogeneity.
claims.evidence_basis: Conceptual argument, unfinished own table, and cited prior balance evidence.
claims.cited_origin: Green et al.2025 and draft TableTBC.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Verified allocation decisions based on outcome-related characteristics beyond the stated rank inputs would undermine quasi-randomness. A prespecified joint covariate diagnostic unusually extreme under a fully specified assignment model would reject that model; small sex-ratio dispersion alone cannot exclude these possibilities.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: The draft says Bihar retained status between 2011 and 2016 whereas UP experienced frequent reassignment since 1995.
claims.qualification: Record as draft claim requiring contemporaneous rules and panel verification; do not infer permanent state regimes.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Stable-boundary Bihar GPs with verified changes between 2011 and 2016 would contradict an absolute freeze. Long, accurately linked UP histories with little reassignment would challenge the draft's broader characterization; no quantitative threshold for frequent rotation is supplied.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.quote: the leadership position in randomly selected village councils for women.
claims.paraphrase: The review describes one-third of council memberships and heads in randomly selected councils as reserved for women.
claims.qualification: Broad summary provides no state-specific allocation algorithm and should not be treated as a national statutory lottery rule.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Following discussion cites Chattopadhyay and Duflo 2004; Beaman et al.2007/2012.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: A documented state-year rule that deterministically selects GP heads using population ranks would contradict the review's literal universal random-selection wording, while leaving its summaries of studies in genuinely randomized settings unaffected.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: The draft acknowledges state-specific rules but describes assignments as generally random, giving chit draws in Madhya Pradesh and alphabetical ordering as examples.
claims.qualification: Alphabetical example is not attached to a specific state or operational sampling interval in the passage.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: For Madhya Pradesh, contemporaneous rules and implementation records showing deterministic selection without the described draw would contradict the chit-draw example. Testing the alphabetical-order example requires a specified state, ordering list and selection interval.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: The estimating equation uses district effects because the district is described as the reservation-assignment unit.
claims.qualification: Body scope differs from abstract; no full district allocation algorithm specified.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Administrative records showing that reservations are independently allocated within subdistrict pools, with separate quota counts and eligibility lists rather than a district-wide pool, would contradict a literal district-as-allocation-pool interpretation.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.procedure: descending number of category-specific female ward seats
claims.paraphrase: General-category women presidencies follow the number of General-women ward seats rather than all women ward seats, contrary to some senior officials' descriptions.
claims.qualification: This is ward-seat ranking, not a census female population-share rule. AppendixA documents lower-level implementation differences.
claims.evidence_basis: Official interviews contrasted with observed reservation histories.
claims.cited_origin: State Election Commission interviews and RDPR officials; author reconstruction.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Complete ward-seat counts and reservation records showing that total women ward seats, rather than General-women seats, consistently determine the disputed General-category assignments would contradict the author's implementation account.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Observed histories support excluding only the immediately preceding women-reserved period; some election officials instead describe exclusion until every GP has served once.
claims.qualification: The author reports conflicting official accounts; does not supply a verified court judgment in this passage.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Jyotiprakash and Veerabadraya 2010; Govindaraju 2010; latter reports High Court interpretation of nikata purva.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Verified consecutive women reservations in unchanged eligible GPs would contradict immediate-period exclusion. Conversely, records showing that earlier reservations impose additional binding exclusions would contradict the claim that only the immediately preceding period matters.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.paraphrase: Reconstructed eligible lists mostly agree with reservations, but officials' descriptions and recorded practice sometimes differ.
claims.qualification: Roughly 5250 of 5626 GPs have complete linked data; transliteration is a material linkage limitation. Some ward-seat counts are estimated.
claims.evidence_basis: Multi-source linkage and author algorithm reconstruction.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Recreating the same eligible lists with the author's actual data and obtaining no reported discrepancies, or discrepancies that disappear once documented linkage errors are resolved, would undermine the corresponding implementation discrepancy claim.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.quote: I cannot rule out that reservation was not randomly assigned.
claims.paraphrase: The author identifies discrepancies even with actual ward-seat counts and excludes every discrepant list from the analysis.
claims.qualification: Lobbying is considered but not established. The retained RD sample cannot quantify the prevalence or consequences of excluded deviations.
claims.evidence_basis: Worked Kethupura/Kotthegala example and stated exclusion rule.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: An analysis-sample membership audit retaining GPs from lists the author classified as discrepant would contradict the stated universal exclusion rule. Verified corrections to the actual ward-seat counts that remove the worked discrepancy would undermine that specific example.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.pool: GPs in population-ratio lists; unit not fully specified here
claims.paraphrase: After caste assignment, GPs are ranked by category population ratio. Ranks 1,4,7 receive 1995 reservations,2,5,8 receive 2001, and 3,6,9 receive 2006.
claims.qualification: Authors call assignment random conditional on slight female-ratio differences; ranking is deterministic given inputs. The passage relies on Ban and Rao rather than an independent roster reconstruction.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Ban and Rao2006 working version; Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act/state election handbook.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: With complete historical lists and resolved ties, a GP assigned a cycle inconsistent with its rank modulo three would contradict this exact assignment algorithm. Checks must use observed histories, not histories inferred from the algorithm.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.pool: GPs in population-ratio lists; unit not fully specified here
claims.paraphrase: After caste assignment, GPs are ranked by category population ratio. Ranks 1,4,7 receive 1995 reservations,2,5,8 receive 2001, and 3,6,9 receive 2006.
claims.qualification: Authors call assignment random conditional on slight female-ratio differences; ranking is deterministic given inputs. The passage relies on Ban and Rao rather than an independent roster reconstruction.
claims.evidence_basis: Institutional description in the cited source.
claims.cited_origin: Ban and Rao 2008; Andhra Pradesh Panchayat Raj Act/state election handbook.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: With complete historical lists and resolved ties, a GP assigned a cycle inconsistent with its rank modulo three would contradict this exact assignment algorithm. Checks must use observed histories, not histories inferred from the algorithm.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.procedure: infer first-cycle status from later cycles
claims.paraphrase: Authors observe no GP reserved in both 2001 and 2006 and infer 1995 reservation for GPs reserved in neither later cycle.
claims.qualification: The inferred 1995 series cannot independently test the once-in-three-cycles assumption used to construct it.
claims.evidence_basis: Linked later-cycle lists; imputed earlier treatment.
claims.cited_origin: 2001 and 2006 GP lists from Andhra Pradesh election commission; footnote 8.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Independent 1995 records assigning an inferred-1995 GP a different status, or verified overlapping women reservations in 2001 and 2006, would contradict the construction's once-per-three-cycles premise.
claims.required_inputs: Complete allocation-pool roster, historical reservation status, and contemporaneous assignment inputs.

claims.pool: Census-linked GP sample separate from YLS
claims.paraphrase: Baseline 1991 Census comparisons and observed later-cycle rotation are offered as support for random assignment.
claims.qualification: Confidentiality prevents matching the Young Lives outcome sample to the same baseline census; this check is on a separate population.
claims.evidence_basis: Reported baseline comparisons; separate sample.
claims.cited_origin: No specific originating assignment document identified in this passage.
claims.implication: Audit this procedure within its stated allocation pool and election cycle; pooled balance alone does not establish implementation fidelity.
claims.contradiction: Independent historical allocations incompatible with the described rotation would contradict its implementation component. A prespecified joint baseline test extreme under the actual allocation model would reject that model; the separate census sample cannot directly validate balance within the confidential YLS sample.

claims.quote: the random allocation of sarpanch seats to women
